summary: Iteration 35 (PWA + dedicated E-Mail tab + full Kalender with iCal sync + Student-Dashboard tiles) tested end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases green (PWA manifest.json + index.html meta-tags, business settings SMTP+calendar_token, appointments CRUD + range list + unscheduled, iCal feed valid/invalid/regen, student summary shape + Stefan-Haas values, legacy bookings router alive). Frontend (Desktop 1600x900 + iPhone 390x844): admin tab order matches spec (students, calendar, accounting, fk_master, business, email, backup, users, content, pages, blog, vku_registrations, packages, certificates, partners, testimonials, gallery, submissions) — legacy 'bookings' tab removed. Kalender tab renders CalendarManager with week/day toggle (7 vs 1 day-header), Zurück/Heute/Weiter, Neuer Termin button, iPhone-Sync button. 224 clickable 30-min slots (6-22h × 7 days × 2 quarters). Termin-Modal opens on slot-click, all 9 fields (customer/start/duration/pickup/notes/phone/email/save/close) present, save creates event pill on grid. iCal modal shows full https://.../api/calendar/{token}.ics URL, Regenerate button rotates token and old feed returns 404. E-Mail tab renders EmailSettingsManager with all 9 SMTP+template fields, 'Verbindung testen' button correctly disabled when host empty. Business tab no longer contains bs-smtp-section (SMTP moved). Student-Summary tiles for Stefan Haas show 1 open invoice CHF 120.00 (accent=warning), 0 upcoming (accent=primary), 0 completed, 11 logged lessons — all 4 tiles data-testids present. PWA meta-tags served (link rel=manifest, apple-mobile-web-app-capable=yes, apple-mobile-web-app-title=SafeRide). Iteration 34 regression: mobile drawer still works, /admin/login redirect intact.
critical_code_review_comments: CalendarManager.jsx is 850+ lines — should be split (CalendarToolbar, CalendarGrid, EventPill, AppointmentModal, ICalModal, UnscheduledList) for maintainability. Non-blocking.

calendar.py: secrets_compare() is defined at bottom of file but referenced in ical_feed above. Works because Python resolves at call time, but readability would improve by moving it near the top or using hmac.compare_digest inline.

AdminAppointmentPatch.status has no enum validation — any string is accepted. Consider Literal['confirmed','pending','cancelled'] to prevent typos from breaking calendar-event color-mapping in the UI.

Legacy public bookings without preferred_date/time are silently dropped from calendar list (fall through _resolve_public_bookings). Non-blocking but a debug log entry would help ops if a booking mysteriously fails to appear.

OverviewTab.next_appointment date-format uses toLocaleString('de-CH') on an ISO with timezone — good — but tile 'Erledigte Termine' subtitle '{n} Termine geplant + erfolgt' repeats the value in the subtitle which reads oddly (e.g. '0 Termine geplant + erfolgt' when there are zero). Minor UX polish.

index.html changes (new manifest link + apple-mobile-web-app-* meta) required a manual `supervisorctl restart frontend` — webpack-dev-server does not hot-reload HTML template changes. If future iterations touch public/index.html, remember to restart the frontend service. Documented here so next agent won't hit the same surprise (initial pytest run failed on this before the restart).
seed_data_creation: None persistent. Each pytest run creates one TEST_ITER35 appointment and deletes it before finishing. Playwright script also cleans up its own TEST_ITER35 UI event.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 35 introduced /api/appointments (admin CRUD), /api/calendar/{token}.ics (PUBLIC — no auth), /api/calendar/regenerate-token, /api/students/{id}/summary. The legacy /api/bookings router remains for backward compatibility and admin-created appointments are stored in the same db.bookings collection with source='admin'. Regenerating the iCal token FROM UI triggers window.confirm() — playwright must attach `page.on('dialog', d.accept)` BEFORE clicking calendar-ical regenerate. When patching frontend/public/index.html, restart the frontend (webpack-dev-server does not hot-reload the HTML template). CalendarManager renders WhenBookings-empty as calendar-unscheduled-* cards; DB has no unscheduled legacy bookings in this env so playwright couldn't exercise the datetime-local + In-Kalender flow (only structurally verified in code — see line 495-540 of CalendarManager.jsx).
rca of the issue: Test-script hiccup (not app bug): first pytest run failed test_index_meta_tags because webpack-dev-server was still serving the pre-edit index.html cached template. Restarting frontend supervisor (`supervisorctl restart frontend`) picked up the new public/index.html and all subsequent checks passed. Recorded as a hint for main agent when touching public/*.html files.
